title: The Interactive Hover (IDE v6)
governingContract: docs/IDE-HONESTY-CONTRACT.md (§12 Hover Interaction Rules, M42 amendment)
prerequisite: M29 completion bar met — verified 9/9, X1 32/32 at HEAD (re-audited by G1 on every run)

issues.scope: Ledger + closure gate + M29 completion-bar re-audit + Hover Interaction Rules machine-gated (contract §12)
acceptanceCriteria: ledger structurally sound, dependency order enforced, X1 last
gate proves it CAN fail: hollow-verified, missing evidence, forged M29 bar each rejected
M29 X1 evidence re-validated at current HEAD by the spawned gate
closureRequirements: verify chain wired with the m42 gate

issues.scope: Semantic in-file DocumentHighlight from the index; staleness-labeled; lexical matching banned
acceptanceCriteria: fixture-first: comment/string tokens must NOT highlight, real references must (RED then GREEN)
editor leg from a freshly-activated extension: highlight ranges equal index reference ranges
mutants: lexical-match provider, staleness-ignoring provider, declaration-only provider each caught
closureRequirements: editor leg evidence with wake-up path

issues.scope: Connected-summary + clickable top usages + definition link in the hover markdown; composes with tiers/staleness/cross-language
acceptanceCriteria: fixture-first: expected markdown authored before the change (RED then GREEN)
differential: every file:line link target equals the index-stored location
editor leg: each link kind navigates in a real session
hover p95 stays <= 50ms with the new sections

issues.scope: Single owner for enrichment reads (src/lsp/enrichment.ts); hover + graph render stored role/pattern/layerFlow/criticality/frequency, labeled as enrichment; presence-gated
acceptanceCriteria: fixture-first: enriched + un-enriched rows, expected output authored before the code (RED then GREEN)
real-db gate: enrichment surfaces end-to-end on a freshly indexed workspace
mutants: parser-fact tier upgrade, fabricated absence, stale enrichment presented fresh each caught
enrichment read adds <= 5ms to hover p95
closureRequirements: graph badge vocabulary extended without tier semantic change

issues.scope: Command URIs (open in graph, impact, call hierarchy) in the hover; server-side symbol resolution; honest error surface
acceptanceCriteria: fixture-first: exact command + argument contract authored before implementation (RED then GREEN)
editor leg: each action produces its surface from a real hover
un-indexed workspace / unknown symbol produce declared errors with remediation, never silent no-ops
commands registered in manifest contributes + README (drift-gated)

issues.scope: Hub = usage/connections center over bb/graph: list<->tree toggle, grouping by file/caller/call-tree, evidence badges, declared truncation; ONE renderer core
acceptanceCriteria: fixture-first: expected list + tree renderings authored before the renderer change (RED then GREEN)
lying-renderer harness extended: fabricated edge, dropped edge, wrong grouping, hidden truncation, unbadged edge each caught
editor leg: hub opens from a real hover action; toggle works
hub open p95 <= 300ms on wave-1 fixture scale
closureRequirements: no second renderer (import-purity + fork ban gates green)
declared truncation on every bounded view

issues.scope: Versioned postMessage contract (navigate/requestRefresh/ack); extension handler validates schema version, reveals file:line, labels stale targets; strict CSP unchanged
acceptanceCriteria: contract doc GENERATED from the live protocol module (byte-identical drift gate)
fixture-first: expected message sequence authored before implementation (RED then GREEN)
editor leg: click-to-reveal works; wrong-version message loudly rejected
mutants: wrong version accepted, stale reveal unlabeled, fabricated path navigation each caught
closureRequirements: CSP gate still strict (W6 suite green)

issues.scope: Program closure for M42 + launch bar: full-ladder audit at HEAD, OS matrix via CI, OpenVSX publish, known-gaps inventory fixed-or-owner-waived, owner spot-check prepared
acceptanceCriteria: ladder green at HEAD (single-pass fixpoint, machine-readable mutant verdicts)
launch record fully populated: per-item evidence or written owner waiver
the gate CAN fail: forged launch record, stale ladder leg, waiver without reason each caught
closureRequirements: owner spot-check scheduled (verdict stays with the owner)
board clean: placeholders closed, no silent gaps
